d284691c6043863d.description:
Overdrive is a hardcore media company programming digital video, photos and audio for a gnarly psychographic that's into dumbass comedy and bare knuckle fighting. While what we make is pure entertainment and this job will be on the entertainment team, our brand team creates a suite of protective gear (starting with tools to prevent overdoses) to monetize and engage consumers with product. Our sponsored and original content is primarily in these verticals: action sports, comedy, music, gaming and combat. We primarily commission content so this job will be focused on dealmaking and relationship development.
Overdrive has an opening for an experienced dealmaker to spearhead new partnerships with talent, media companies and organizations. The ideal candidate must have extensive experience as a seller (producer/studio), producer, and/or buyer/commissioner (network) in content development/production or at a studio/management company—as well as deep knowledge of the creative and business/legal process from idea to launch. Must have proven creative instincts ideating, developing, and closing talent and unscripted media projects as well as strong interpersonal skills and relationships.
Location: Remote
Compensation: The target compensation for this role is $10,000-12,000 per month. Contract or Salary. Preference is a 3-month contract to start.
We will count on you to:

• Manage relationships with talent and key partners

• Exercise excellent creative and business judgement, tracking entertainment trends, and developing breakthrough original formats

• Build relationships with buyers, key stakeholders at Overdrive, talent, artist representatives and the greater creative community

• Lead and manage the curation of talent/media outreach and pipeline of creators

• Lead dealmaking and closing process with various creative partners

• Liaise with other departments including Brand, Publicity, Finance and Legal Affairs

Basic qualifications:

• 5+ years of creative executive or representation experience brokering talent/activation/sponsorship/media deals

• Deep understanding of the nuts and bolts of development, including ideation, creation of pitch materials, production, and dealmaking. Including experience working with digital creators and distributing on digital platforms

• Experience working with other departments such as casting, production, research, PR, business and legal affairs

• Experience with all creative aspects of video/photo development production and post production

d2cbb7815e3df6fb.description: Job Summary About the Role: We are seeking a skilled and experienced Data Analyst III to join our team. The ideal candidate will apply their deep understanding of quantitative analysis, investigative analytics, and data presentation to develop and maintain complex reports and dashboards that significantly impact leadership decisions. As a Data Analyst III, you will partner with workstream leads, business analysts, and product teams to provide subject matter expertise on data, ensuring measurable outcomes and validating experiments. You will leverage cross-functional relationships with key stakeholders to understand business needs, define problems, and ensure your analysis and insights align with business objectives. This role is pivotal in transforming raw data into clear, actionable narratives that inform critical business decisions. Key Responsibilities - Advanced Analytics & Insight Delivery: Lead the development and maintenance of complex reports, dashboards, and data models. Apply expertise in quantitative analysis and data mining to deliver actionable analytics and insights that drive strategic decisions. - Stakeholder Partnership & Communication: Serve as a key liaison between the data team and internal stakeholders. Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, present findings to senior management, and influence decision-making through clear, data-driven recommendations. - Project Leadership & Collaboration: Independently manage and coordinate data analytics projects from inception to completion. Partner with cross-functional teams to define requirements, mitigate risks, and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality, valuable solutions. - Data Product Lifecycle Management: Participate in all phases of the internal data product lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and post-launch optimization, with a focus on driving continuous improvement. - Mentorship & Best Practices: Mentor and review the work of junior data analysts, providing guidance on best practices, methodologies, and technical skills to foster a culture of excellence and continuous learning within the team. - Data Governance & Quality: Actively identify and bring awareness to data quality, integrity, and accessibility issues. Lead efforts to implement best practices and report on data discrepancies to ensure the reliability of our data assets. Qualifications & Skills Technical Skills - SQL: Ability to write and troubleshoot complex queries involving joins, aggregations, subqueries, and CTEs. - Data Visualization and BI Tooling: Hands-on experience building dashboards, reports, and visualizations in at least one enterprise BI platform (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) with a strong understanding of chart selection, filtering, and end-user usability. - Spreadsheet Fluency: Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, lookup/index-match functions, conditional logic, and data cleanup techniques. - Cloud Data Platform Exposure: Familiarity with a modern data warehouse or lakehouse environment such as Snowflake or Databricks. - Data Quality and Validation: Demonstrated ability to profile datasets, identify anomalies and gaps, reconcile figures across sources, and document assumptions and known limitations. - AI-Enabled Analytics: Explores and applies emerging technologies, including the development of AI-powered agents and automated solutions, to streamline analytical workflows and help business stakeholders access insights more efficiently. - Business Systems Awareness: General understanding of enterprise systems such as CRM (Salesforce). - Product & Customer Telemetry Analysis (Preferred): Experience working with high-volume, event-based data (e.g., product usage or application logs) to analyze customer behavior, measure feature adoption, and identify performance trends. - Statistical Programming (Preferred): Proficiency in a statistical programming language like Python for advanced data manipulation, automation, and statistical analysis is a strong plus. Analytical and Business Skills - Strong attention to detail with a habit of self-auditing work before it reaches a stakeholder. - Proven ability to translate an ambiguous business question into a structured, answerable analysis with a defined scope, metric definitions, and success criteria. - Solid communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. - Minimum of 5 years of experience in data analytics, with a proven track record of leading data projects. The Job Description is intended to be a general representation of the responsibilities and requirements of the job. However, the description may not be all-inclusive, and responsibilities and requirements are subject to change. .

d2ba658ba1f583ed.description: Job Tittle: IT ExecutiveShift: Rotational shiftLocation BangaloreAbout the company Pixis (Leapus Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) is a next-generation marketing-AI platform that harnesses the targeting capabilities of social media and digital advertising platforms. It takes an end-to-end approach to the identification, creation, and optimisation of ads  collecting data, understanding target-group behaviour, creating the ad, and delivering the right content at the right time, so every customer receives uniquely relevant advertising on a one-to-one basis. Pixis works with brands such as Swiggy, Amazon, Rapido, HDFC Bank, TATA AIG, Yes Bank, GoAir, Livspace, and MPL Gaming, delivering an average upside of around 50% on CPL, CPI, CPC, and CPM, along with a significant improvement in acquired customer LTV. Role summary The IT Executive handles day-to-day IT support for employees, maintains the IT asset inventory, manages the office network, and assists the IT Manager with new IT projects and system rollouts. The role requires a minimum of 2 years of hands-on IT operations experience and a strong, practical grasp of IT infrastructure and best practices. Scope The role is based in Bangalore, India and supports the Bangalore office and India-based employees, with remote support extended to other Pixis group entities as needed. The IT Executive works closely with the People team on new-hire and exit processes and with vendors on hardware procurement and repairs.Key responsibilities Responsibilities are organised by area and are carried out under the direction of the IT Manager. IT Support  Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and access issues for employees on macOS, Windows, and mobile devices.  Log and track tickets, resolve them within agreed timelines, and escalate to the IT Manager when needed.  Set up laptops and accounts for new hires; recover devices and revoke access when employees exit.  Maintain simple how-to guides and conduct IT orientation for new employees.IT Asset Inventory  Maintain an up-to-date inventory of all hardware assets  assignment, serial number, condition, warranty, and location.  Coordinate laptop procurement, tagging, deployment, repairs, and secure disposal of old equipment.  Track software licenses and remove unused licenses to control cost.Network Management Manage and monitor the office network  firewalls, switches, Wi-Fi access points, and internet links.  Troubleshoot connectivity and performance issues; make routine configuration changes as approved.  Keep network documentation current and coordinate with ISP and building IT teams when required.IT Projects & Systems Assist in the design and deployment of new IT systems and services  office setups, network upgrades, and tool rollouts.  Assess vendors and test new hardware and software before company-wide rollout.  Document setup steps and standards for the changes delivered.Monitoring & Improvement Monitor the performance of IT systems and report issues, ticket trends, and costs to the IT Manager.  Recommend improvements to IT infrastructure, tools, and processes.  Ensure endpoint security basics are in place  device management enrolment, patching, and antivirus/EDR coverage.Vendor Coordination Liaise with hardware suppliers, repair centres, ISPs, and software vendors for quotes, orders, warranty claims, and renewals.  Maintain vendor contact details and the renewal calendar.Required qualifications Minimum 2 years of experience working in IT operations or IT support. Excellent working knowledge of computer systems, security, network and systems administration, databases and data storage systems, and phone systems.  Hands-on experience with office networking  firewalls, switches, and access points  including basic configuration and troubleshooting.Working knowledge of Windows and macOS troubleshooting, and of Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 user administration. Strong critical thinking and decision-making skills. Excellent IT skills and a strong ability to prioritise across tickets, projects, and walk-up requests. A firm grasp of IT infrastructure and operations best practices. Good communication skills  able to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical employees and leadership.
